newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: Billiton option exercised, new shares issued.
newsitem.headline: Billiton option exercised, new shares issued.

text.p: Billiton Plc said on Friday that its underwriters had exercised the manager's option to subscribe for a further 56.20 million ordinary shares in Billiton at the placing price of 220p.
The recently London and Johannesburg listed base metals group said in a published announcement that the period during which stabilisation transactions may be carried out had therefore ended.
Following the exercise of this option, the total size of the international placing offer was 431.25 million ordinary shares amounting to 949 million stg.

The new shares in Billiton, which was unbundled from South African mining house Gencor Ltd, will be listed on the London Stock Exchange and the Johannesburg Stock Exchange during the course of next week.
It will increase the Billiton issued share caital to just below 2.14 billion shares.
